name: tiktok-live-mcp

tools.name: check_live
tools.description: Check whether one or more TikTok creators are currently live streaming. Returns live status and room id for each. Requires Basic tier or above; on Sandbox use get_live_status instead, which checks one creator at a time.

tools.name: get_live_status
tools.description: Fast liveness check for a single creator. Returns is_live plus the room id. Available on every tier.

tools.name: get_room_info
tools.description: Get full live room details for a creator: stream title, current viewer count, how long they have been live, and host profile. Only returns data while the creator is live. Requires Basic tier or above.

tools.name: get_creator_profile
tools.description: Reverse-lookup a full TikTok creator profile by username: nickname, bio, verification, avatar, follower and video counts. Requires Pro tier or above.

tools.name: get_gift_catalog
tools.description: Get the TikTok LIVE gift catalog: gift id, display name, diamond cost and icon. Works with no arguments and returns the global catalog. Pass a username to include gifts unlocked only in that creator's live room. Available on every tier; Sandbox and Basic receive a 50-gift sample, Pro and above receive the full catalog.

username.description: Optional creator whose live room the catalog is scoped to

search.description: Optional case-insensitive filter on the gift name

tools.name: get_gift_gallery
tools.description: Get a creator's live gift wishlist: the gifts they selected as goals, with progress. The creator must be live right now. Available on every tier.

tools.name: get_live_feed
tools.description: Discover TikTok streams that are live right now in a region, with title, host and viewer count. Requires Pro tier or above.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Get the TikTok LIVE creator leaderboard for a region, ranked by diamonds earned. type=daily works on every tier but creator identifiers stay masked below Pro. type=league requires Ultra tier. type=weekly, type=gaming and type=shopping require Agency tier.

tools.name: get_popular_live
tools.description: Get TikTok's real-time Popular LIVE board for a region, the creators TikTok is actively featuring. Available on every tier, but creator identifiers stay masked until Global Agency tier.

tools.name: find_eligible_creators
tools.description: Find creators eligible to recruit in a region, score-ranked. This is the feed behind an agency recruiting dashboard. Requires Global Agency tier; lower tiers receive an upgrade message.

tools.name: get_rate_limits
tools.description: Check the current API key's tier, request limits, remaining quota and WebSocket allowance. Available on every tier.
